description: Workload: total teaching hours per teacher. New endpoint GET /api/dashboard/workload (HOD sees all; a teacher only their own), an HOD 'Workload' tab on the Reports page (Fairness.jsx) with a date-range/week picker, and a 'My teaching hours' card on the Dashboard for everyone. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 (it only creates shared helpers schedule_utils.py and dateUtils.js that FEAT-002/003 reuse).
steps: Create backend/app/services/schedule_utils.py: slot_minutes(slot) (parse 'HH:MM' start_time/end_time of a TimeSlot), week_bounds(d) -> (Monday, Saturday), iter_teaching_dates(start, end) -> Mon-Sat dates only, round_hours(minutes) -> round(minutes/60, 2). Never hardcode 55 min.

Re-read backend/app/schemas.py then add WorkloadDay{day_of_week:int, day_name:str, periods:int, hours:float}, WorkloadRow{teacher_id:int, name:str, role:Role, scheduled_periods_per_week:int, scheduled_hours_per_week:float, scheduled_hours_in_range:float, hours_substituted_for_others:float, periods_substituted_for_others:int, hours_given_up:float, periods_given_up:int, uncovered_hours:float, net_hours_in_range:float, daily:list[WorkloadDay] (always 6 items Mon..Sat)} and WorkloadReport{start:date, end:date, teaching_days:int, formula:str, rows:list[WorkloadRow]}.

In backend/app/routers/dashboard.py add GET /api/dashboard/workload?start=&end=&teacher_id= (response_model=WorkloadReport), using Depends(get_current_teacher) (import from app.security; the other endpoints in this file stay require_hod). Non-HOD: ignore/force teacher_id to own id and raise 403 if a different teacher_id is requested. Defaults: start/end = Monday/Saturday of the week containing today. 400 if start > end or range > 366 days. Rows for all active teachers (or the one requested).

Computation: load active TimetableEntry rows (is_active) with time_slot joined once. A teacher's entries = rows where teacher_id==t OR co_teacher_id==t (co-taught lab counts for both; a double block is 2 rows = 2 periods). scheduled_periods_per_week = count; scheduled_hours_per_week = round_hours(sum slot_minutes). daily[] = per weekday 0..5 periods+hours. scheduled_hours_in_range = sum over iter_teaching_dates(start,end) of that weekday's minutes. Substitutions with override_date in [start,end]: status ASSIGNED and substitute_teacher_id==t -> hours_substituted_for_others/periods_substituted; ASSIGNED and absent_teacher_id==t -> hours_given_up/periods_given_up; UNCOVERED and absent_teacher_id==t -> uncovered_hours. Duration of a substitution = slot_minutes(sub.timetable_entry.time_slot). net_hours_in_range = scheduled_in_range - given_up - uncovered + substituted (put this text in `formula`). Round every hour value to 2 decimals (compute in minutes, round once at the end).

Restart the backend on 8010 (stop the process from Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8010, start fresh uvicorn in background from backend dir, wait for /api/health) and verify the endpoint (see verification).

Create frontend/src/dateUtils.js: localISO(date) (local y-m-d, NOT toISOString), weekBounds(isoStr) -> {start: Monday, end: Saturday}, addDays(isoStr, n). Add api.workload(start, end, teacherId) to frontend/src/api.js (re-read first), building the query string only from provided params.

Create frontend/src/components/WorkloadPanel.jsx (HOD): controls row (From/To date inputs, '< Prev week', 'This week', 'Next week >' buttons that move start/end by 7 days, default current Mon-Sat) loading via api.workload; SkeletonRows while loading; error div; table inside <div className='scroll-x'> with columns Teacher | Scheduled h/wk | Substituted h | Given up h | Net h | bar (existing .bar-track/.bar-fill scaled to the max net hours) | daily mini-bars (6 tiny columns Mon-Sat, height proportional to hours, title tooltip 'Mon 1.83 h'); a totals row; show the `formula` text as small helper text. Show periods in a title/tooltip or small sub-text.

Re-read frontend/src/pages/Fairness.jsx and add a seg toggle ('Fairness' | 'Workload', using existing .seg/.seg-btn) so the Workload tab renders <WorkloadPanel />; do not change the existing fairness report logic or output. Keep PageHeader (update subtitle to mention workload).

Create frontend/src/components/MyHoursCard.jsx: calls api.workload(start,end,user.teacher_id) for the current week, shows scheduled h/week (big number), this week net hours, substituted and given-up hours, and the 6 daily mini-bars; SkeletonRows while loading; silently hides on error. Re-read frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx and render <MyHoursCard /> as the first child of <div className='dash-col-side'> for all roles.

Append a '/* ---- Workload ---- */' block to the end of frontend/src/styles.css (re-read the end of file first): .wl-table helpers, .wl-days (flex of 6 bars, align-items:flex-end, fixed height ~28px) / .wl-day (bar using --color-signal-blue or --color-orange), .wl-controls (wrap on mobile), .wl-total row, .my-hours card styles; include @media (max-width:640px) rules. Use theme variables only.

Re-read frontend/src/pages/Help.jsx and add one FAQ entry (tags: hours, workload, teaching load): 'Where can I see how many hours a teacher teaches?' explaining Reports -> Workload (HOD) and the 'My teaching hours' card on the Dashboard (everyone), and how net hours are computed. Update the 'Reports' TOPIC body to mention workload.
Run `npm run build` in frontend (fix errors), then delete frontend/dist. Do the browser/proxy check.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/dashboard/workload with the HOD token returns one row per active teacher (14) with all fields above; Mr. Vipin has scheduled_periods_per_week=9 and scheduled_hours_per_week=8.25; Anjana has 13 and 11.92.

For every teacher, scheduled_periods_per_week equals the count from /api/timetable/view/teacher/{id} and scheduled_hours_per_week equals round(periods*55/60, 2); sum of daily[].periods == scheduled_periods_per_week; lab blocks count as 2 periods; co-taught labs count for both teachers.

For start=2026-10-26&end=2026-10-31 Dr. Spurgen's hours_given_up equals the summed duration of his ASSIGNED substitutions that week (cross-check with GET /api/substitutions?on=2026-10-26) and the substitutes' hours_substituted_for_others add up to the same total; net_hours_in_range follows the formula.
A teacher token (spurgen@college.edu) gets only their own row and a 403 when passing another teacher_id; start>end returns 400.
Reports page shows a Workload tab with the table, bars, daily mini-bars, and week picker; Dashboard shows the My teaching hours card; Fairness tab still behaves as before.
`npm run build` passes; no browser console errors; layouts hold at 390 px width.
verification: Restart uvicorn on 8010, then Invoke-RestMethod login (HOD) and GET http://127.0.0.1:8010/api/dashboard/workload; script comparing every teacher's numbers with a hand count from /api/timetable/view/teacher/{id} x 55 min (expect 0 mismatches); check Vipin=9 periods and Anjana=13
GET workload?start=2026-10-26&end=2026-10-31 and cross-check substituted/given-up hours with /api/substitutions?on=...
Teacher token: own row only; other teacher_id -> 403
cd frontend; npm run build  (then delete frontend/dist)
Browser (or Edge headless / Vite proxy fetch http://localhost:5173/api/dashboard/workload): Reports -> Workload, Dashboard card, 1280px and 390px, no console errors
findings: Backend: services/schedule_utils.py (slot_minutes, week_bounds, iter_teaching_dates, round_hours); GET /api/dashboard/workload in routers/dashboard.py (get_current_teacher; non-HOD forced to own id, 403 otherwise; 400 on start>end or >366d). Verified on 8010: 14 rows, 0 mismatches vs teacher views, Vipin 9/8.25, Anjana 13/11.92, Spurgen 26-31 Oct given_up 5 periods/4.58h (Sameeran 3, Anjana 1, Soumya 1). Frontend: dateUtils.js (localISO, weekBounds, addDays), api.workload(start,end,teacherId), components WorkloadPanel/MyHoursCard/DayBars, Reports Workload tab (Fairness.jsx), Help FAQ, CSS block '/* ---- Workload ---- */'. npm run build OK, dist deleted. Browser screenshots not taken; verified via Vite proxy only. Backend 8010 and Vite 5173 left running. Not committed. Note: Fairness.jsx CSV/PDF export uses apiUrl('/dashboard/...') without /api (pre-existing, untouched).
